meta.title: PlusVibeAPI balance
meta.description: Shows the remaining PlusVibeAPI balance beside the composer's context meter whenever the selected model routes through plusvibeapi.ru, using that provider's own API key. Click the reading for today's, this month's, and this chat's spend, a per-day spend chart, and a link to the account page. Balance, usage, price list, and history are fetched by the Host half, so the key never reaches the page. Nothing is shown for a model routed anywhere else. Unofficial and non-commercial: not affiliated with or endorsed by PlusVibeAPI, the author receives nothing from it, and its name and mark are used only to name the service it works with — the mark will be removed on the owner's request.
